This page lists 51 Kitty Terminal keyboard shortcuts for macOS, grouped by area. They come from the community `kitty.keyly` template for [Keyly](/), a free, open-source menu bar app: install the template once, then double-tap `⇪ Caps Lock` in Kitty Terminal to see them next to the shortcuts Keyly reads from the app's menus.

## Install the template

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hoaiphongdev/keyly/main/scripts/install-templates.sh | bash -s -- -t kitty.keyly
```

This saves the template to `~/.config/keyly/templates/kitty.keyly`. It targets `/Applications/kitty.app`; if Kitty Terminal lives elsewhere on your Mac, [update the app path](/configuration/templates/). New to Keyly? Start with [Getting Started](/getting-started/).

## Scrolling

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘↑` | Scroll line up |
| `⌘↓` | Scroll line down |
| `⌥⌘⇞` | Scroll line up (alt) |
| `⌥⌘⇟` | Scroll line down (alt) |
| `⌘⇞` | Scroll page up |
| `⌘⇟` | Scroll page down |
| `⌘↖` | Scroll to top |
| `⌘↘` | Scroll to bottom |

## Tabs

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘T` | New tab |
| `⌘W` | Close tab |
| `⌃⇥` | Next tab |
| `⇧⌘]` | Next tab (alt) |
| `⌃⇧⇥` | Previous tab |
| `⇧⌘[` | Previous tab (alt) |
| `⌃⇧.` | Move tab forward |
| `⌃⇧,` | Move tab backward |
| `⇧⌘I` | Set tab title |

## Windows

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘⏎` | New window |
| `⌘N` | New OS window |
| `⇧⌘D` | Close window |
| `⌃⇧]` | Next window |
| `⌃⇧[` | Previous window |
| `⌃⇧F` | Move window forward |
| `⌃⇧B` | Move window backward |
| `` ⌃⇧` `` | Move window to top |
| `⌘1-9` | Focus specific window |
| `⌃⇧L` | Switch to next layout |

## Clipboard

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘C` | Copy to clipboard |
| `⌘V` | Paste from clipboard |
| `⌃⇧S` | Paste from selection |

## Font Size

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘+` | Increase font size |
| `⌘-` | Decrease font size |
| `⌘0` | Restore font size |

## Display

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌃⌘F` | Toggle fullscreen |
| `⌃⇧F10` | Toggle maximized |

## Shell Integration

Requires shell integration enabled.

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌃⇧G` | View output of last command |
| `⌃⇧Z` | Previous prompt in scrollback |
| `⌃⇧X` | Next prompt in scrollback |

## Background Opacity

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌃⇧A M` | Increase background opacity |
| `⌃⇧A L` | Decrease background opacity |
| `⌃⇧A 1` | Full background opacity |
| `⌃⇧A D` | Reset background opacity |

## Other

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌃⌘Space` | Input unicode character |
| `⌃⇧E` | Click URL with keyboard |
| `⌃⇧⌫` | Reset the terminal |
| `⌃⌘F5` | Reload kitty.conf |
| `⌘⌥F6` | Debug kitty.conf |
| `⌃⇧O` | Pass selection to program |
| `⌃⇧F2` | Edit kitty config file |
| `⌃⇧F1` | View kitty docs in browser |
| `⌃⇧⎋` | Open a kitty shell |

## Template file

The full [`kitty.keyly`](https://github.com/hoaiphongdev/keyly/blob/main/templates/kitty.keyly) file. Copy it into `~/.config/keyly/templates/` to edit it, or [write your own](/configuration/custom-shortcuts/).
